Name: Seashell Crab Pots
Author: AnimeGirl4Lyfe
Description:
This mod is inspired by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6818]Cute Crab Pots[/url] mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/24986819]Gervig91[/url].

There are 5 available colors to choose from: Blue, Green, Pink, Purple, and Yellow. 

Please open config.json and edit the "Color" field to the color you want your crab pots to be. For example, "Color": "Purple". Note that this is case sensitive and the color you entered must start with a capital letter.

Manifest.Name: Seashell Crab Pots
Manifest.Description: Replace the default crab pots with cute seashells
Manifest.Author: cherribunny
